text:
Marina Chen: Heads-up — opening a docs PR that consolidates the Dedicated provisioning playbook, updates the autoscale example to include healthchecks, and tweaks SLA phrasing around isolation. Wanted to flag here before I push.
Kevin Patel: Thanks Marina. Can you call out what exact SLA wording you want changed? legal asked for less absolutist language last week.
Marina Chen: Yep — change 'guaranteed' -> 'targeted' and add a sentence about best-effort for cross-tenant burst fallback. Sample: 'We target 99.9% availability for Dedicated tenants; cross-tenant fallback is treated as best-effort and may incur higher latency.'
Lia Gomez: Also please update the eviction wording in the isolation section. Ops prefers 'preemption' + a short paragraph on signal flow (SIGTERM -> drain -> migrate).
Ryan O'Neil: On the autoscale example, can we include a healthcheck probe so nodes don't spin up endlessly for misconfigured apps? small YAML snippet would help.
Marina Chen: Good call. I'll add an autoscale YAML with a healthProbe block and an SDK example to show how to set tenant labels that opt into reserved pools.
Marina Chen (cont): Proposed YAML snippet inline for review:
```yaml
autoscale_policy:
  min_instances: 2
  max_instances: 20
  scale_window: 60s
  cpu_threshold_pct: 70
  health_probe:
    path: /healthz
    interval: 15s
    failure_threshold: 3
```
Ryan O'Neil: LGTM for the YAML. Add a note that health_probe must respond <500 and <200ms for optimal decisions.
Kevin Patel: For the SDK snippet, show both Python and CLI. People always want copy/paste.
Marina Chen: Draft Python SDK snippet below — keeps it minimal and focused on tenant label + reservation flag:
```python
from redwood import DedicatedClient
client = DedicatedClient(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
client.create_capacity(
  tenant_id="tenant-123",
  capacity_name="reserved-gpu-pool",
  labels={"workload": "low-latency", "isolation": "reserved"},
  reservation=True
)
```
Lia Gomez: Could you add a migration note: older terraform module had `tenant_labels` -> new SDK expects `labels` and `reservation` is explicit. People hit this during onboarding.
Marina Chen: Will do — adding a quick migration snippet and a link to the terraform changelog. Also fixing a few stale links in the provisioning checklist page (broken link to the quota matrix).
Sara Li: I can help with link fixes and a quick test pass on staging docs site after you merge. Ping me when PR is up.
Marina Chen: Awesome — will push in ~30m. Tests locally passed except one flakey example rendering on Windows; I'll remove OS-specific instructions.
docs-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/8242 — title: "Dedicated: autoscale healthchecks, SLA phrasing, isolation wording". Assigning reviewers: @kevin, @lia.
Kevin Patel: Reviewing now. Noting one language nit in the SLA paragraph (suggest replace 'best-effort' with 'may be subject to capacity constraints').
Lia Gomez: I'm checking the isolation section; can we add a diagram (svg) of signal flow? I'll prepare one and upload to the PR as a follow-up.
Ryan O'Neil: Once merged, Ops needs a heads-up 24h before rollout so we can monitor eviction/preemption metrics.
Marina Chen: Noted — will schedule a quick oncall ping. Also adding a short rollback step for tenants if the new autoscale behaves poorly (manual scale command + annotation to opt-out of prefix-cache).
Sara Li: Link fix list from QA: 1) quota-matrix -> correct path 2) terraform module doc -> new module path 3) SDK auth examples -> update env var name. I'll include patches in the PR.
Kevin Patel: quick approve pending two tiny wording edits. :thumbsup:
Marina Chen: Thanks all — merging once CI green. Will follow up with migration note and Lia's diagram. :shipit:
Sara Li: I'll run the staging link checks after merge and post back here.
docs-bot: CI passed for docs PR #8242 — build: success.
Marina Chen: Merged. Deploying to staging now. Thanks everyone for quick turnaround! :tada:
